entities.name: Stanisław Tatar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Tatar nom de guerre "Stanisław Tabor" was a Polish Army colonel in the interwar period and, during World War II, one of the commanders of Armia Krajowa, Polish resistance movement. He was appointed brigade general in 1943 and half-a-year later flew from occupied Poland to London.

entities.summary: Stanisław Tatar nom de guerre "Stanisław Tabor" was a Polish Army colonel in the interwar period and, during World War II, one of the commanders of Armia Krajowa, Polish resistance movement. He was appointed brigade general in 1943 and half-a-year later flew from occupied Poland to London.
